# Step Analysis
The recorded steps demonstrate updating an order status in Magento admin. The agent:
1. Navigated to order view page (after login issues)
2. Analyzed the order status update form structure
3. Interacted with all form elements: status dropdown, comment textarea, notify customer checkbox, visible on frontend checkbox, and submit button
4. Successfully submitted a test update

# Task Definition
Create a tool to update order status with comment and notification settings in Magento admin.

# Action Plan
1. Navigate to the specific order view page using order_id parameter
2. Fill the order status update form with provided parameters
3. Submit the form to update the order

# Variable Identification
From the interactions, I need these parameters:
1. order_id (required) - The order ID to update
2. status (required) - Order status to set (dropdown selection)
3. comment (required) - Comment text to add
4. notify_customer (optional) - Whether to notify customer by email (checkbox)
5. visible_on_frontend (optional) - Whether comment is visible on frontend (checkbox)

# Step Optimization
- Remove login steps (agent is already logged in per instructions)
- Remove exploration of filtering/sorting controls (not part of core task)
- Use elementHash for stable element targeting where available
- Keep essential steps only: navigation, form filling, submission
- Add wait step after navigation to ensure page loads
- Use deterministic steps for form elements with elementHash
name: update_order_status
description: Updates the status of a specific Magento order with a comment and optional notification settings

steps.description: Navigate to the specific order view page
Wait for page to load completely
Toggle notify customer checkbox if needed
Toggle visible on frontend checkbox if needed
Submit the order status update form
